items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I think that was his original name. Jacinto Chabania. That was his original name, I think. He was part Spanish and part Black, and he used to jump the fence all the time.

ctx.x: He changed his name to Jacinto Chabania or something like that...

I think that was his original name. Jacinto Chabania. That was his original name, I think. He was part Spanish and part Black, and he used to jump the fence all the time. His wife, I think she was jumping the fence, too. I don't think she was Black.
